status: finite diagnostic; not an error-certified probability estimate

uniform_tau_mixture.note: log_mean_Z_including_dead is an equal-tau mixture mean, not Z2_sum_over_tau.

notes: All log-sum-exp calculations include dead replicates as zero weights.
ESS and max_weight_share use Z weights within the stated finite set.
The cross-domain R=2 probes are throughput/format references only, not stability evidence.

Z2_sum_over_tau.note: This is 255 times the uniform-tau mixture mean Z; Q is unchanged by that common factor.

ESS_interpretation: The all-record ESS/max-share mixes tau strata with genuinely different masses; it is reported only as a mixture diagnostic, not by itself as a variance claim. Per-tau ESS/max_weight_share are the direct finite-sample concentration diagnostics.
